event: A new online-only Must-See Deals week opened at Home Depot today and runs to Sept 30, and the Weekly Depot Drop list turned over with it — 35 items now, down from 105, and not one of them is DEWALT or Husky. Running alongside it is a new Pro Savings Event ending Oct 7, whose only DEWALT offers are 20V MAX bundles (buy a 20V battery or XR POWERPACK, get a free 20V tool; buy a 20V tool, get a free 5.0Ah battery and charger kit) — again no 60V FlexVolt and no Husky tool-storage event pricing

coverage.name: Home Depot Canada
coverage.note: Anchor — batteries, 60V tools, and the only source for Husky benches. All 36 tracked Home Depot SKUs held their price for a twelfth straight day, and the three sweeps turned up nothing that beats a row already on the board: the FlexVolt battery search returned 115 items whose only visible markdowns are SKUs already tracked (DCB609C 13%, DCST972X1 12%, DCCS670X1 14%), the 61-inch Husky search returned 15 with no 61-incher under $999 on sale, and the 72-inch search returned 26 whose only new model, the H72MWC15DL at $1,682, is full price and $283 over target. Two stock moves are worth noting: the matte-grey 72-inch heavy-duty bench has gone from 4 available to 8, and the DCCS670X1 chainsaw kit has ship-to-store back (3 at Windermere) after reading delivery-only. Shelf position at Windermere: the DCB606 holds at 3, the DCB609 and DCB609C at 3, the DCB609-2 at 4, the DCB606-2 at 5, the DCB6112 at 3 and the DCB612 now reads a firm 2 rather than yesterday's vague limited stock, both still out of stock online. The DCS578B holds at 1, the DCS389B at 2, the DCG418B at 3, the DCBL777B at 6, the DCHT870B and DCPW1000B at 5. The only online count to thin is the DCST972B trimmer, 43 to 41

coverage.name: Alberta Drywall & Stucco Supply
coverage.note: Edmonton contractor supplier at 6030 50 St NW. Every tracked row held on both price and stock for a third day — DCB606 $175 with 5, DCS388 $309.99 with 3, refurbished DCV585BR $395 with 5, refurbished DCD130B $279 with its last unit, DCBL770X1 bare tool $297 with 3, DCST970X1 bare tool $279 with 4, and the refurbished 21-inch snow blower kit at $1,099 with 3. Both sweeps grew again — "flexvolt 60v" from 19 items to 20 and "dewalt refurbished" from 179 to 194 — and a narrower "refurbished 60v max" sweep was run on top to catch anything the broad one buried, but there is still no refurbished 60V bare tool here beyond the DCV585BR and DCD130B already tracked. The only FlexVolt-badged refurbished addition is the same 20V DCD999 hammer drill at $159, 46% off, which is FlexVolt Advantage and not a 60V tool. The $315 DCD575-labelled "Flex Volt 60V 7¼" circular saw" is still listed and still left off

coverage.name: KMS Tools
coverage.note: Full FlexVolt dealer with an Edmonton store. Re-checked Sept 24 and nothing moved at all — DCB612 $328 and DCS578B $398 both still badged Super Special under MAP pricing, the DCBL772X1 blower kit still $418 on Clearance, all three in stock online, and the Abbotsford counts frozen where they were yesterday: 9 on the saw, 2 on the blower kit, still sold out on the DCB612. KMS's monthly Flipp flyer runs to Oct 1 and still carries the only FlexVolt-branded flyer items in the postal code

coverage.name: Grainger Canada
coverage.note: Supplying two packs, both unchanged on the dated markdown: DCB606 $205.99 from $350.94 and DCB612 $345.99 from $518.71, with the offer end date still reading 30 Oct 2026 on both pages. Worth recording for next time: the site's sign-in modal suppresses the price block entirely on first load, so a blank price here means the modal was in the way, not that the sale ended. Availability needs a postal code and both packs are flagged for special shipping

coverage.name: Walmart.ca
coverage.note: Read cleanly again on Sept 24 and the DCB612 is confirmed at $328, sold and shipped by Preston Hardware. The free seller delivery window has slipped a week, from Fri Sept 25 to Thu Oct 1. At $27.33/Ah it still ties KMS as the cheapest 12Ah pack on the board

coverage.name: Canadian Tire
coverage.note: Re-swept Sept 24 and still carries no 60V FlexVolt, but the search itself came back to life: "dewalt 60v" returned 18 results today after three days stuck at 2, and "flexvolt 60v battery" returned 65. The wider net changes nothing — every DEWALT hit is 12V or 20V MAX (DCB104 charger, DCA1820 adaptor, DCR025 radio, DCB1800B power station, assorted 20V kits), and the only 60V items in the battery search are Greenworks and EGO. No 60V pack, no bare 60V tool, no Husky

coverage.name: Amazon.ca
coverage.note: Both tracked rows held their price, but the bare saw is nearly gone. The DCS578B is still $299 from cell phone seller with $14.94 delivery, now quoted Oct 7–14, and stock has dropped from 3 units to 1 — so the cheapest bare DCS578B anywhere is one purchase away from disappearing. The DCB609 is steady at $334 in stock from Impact Distribution with FREE delivery Oct 6–14, its thirteenth day at that landed cost. Battery searches are still wall-to-wall third-party replacement packs

log.text: A twelfth straight day with not one tracked price moving — all 51 rows across Home Depot, KMS, Grainger, Walmart, Amazon and Alberta Drywall read back at their last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the only pack inside the $24/Ah strong-buy line, the DCB612 at $328 from both KMS and Walmart still ties as the cheapest 12Ah at $27.33/Ah, and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. What changed is the calendar: Home Depot turned its week over, so a new online-only Must-See Deals week now runs to Sept 30, the Weekly Depot Drop list shrank from 105 items to 35 with no DEWALT or Husky in it, and a new Pro Savings Event opened ending Oct 7 whose only DEWALT offers are 20V MAX give-away bundles — no 60V FlexVolt and no Husky tool-storage pricing in any of the three. The sharpest supply note is on Amazon: the $299 DCS578B bare saw, the cheapest bare one anywhere, is down from 3 units to 1 and now quotes Oct 7–14, so it may not survive the week. Against that, two things got easier to buy — the matte-grey 72-inch heavy-duty Husky bench went from 4 available to 8 at $1,548 from $1,898 (18% off, still $149 over the $1,399 line), and the DCCS670X1 chainsaw kit has ship-to-store back with 3 held at Windermere after reading delivery-only. The 61-inch gloss-white bench is thinning the other way, down to 3 online with none on the shelf. No new SKU earned a row: Home Depot's battery search (115 items) put its only markdowns on SKUs already tracked, the two Husky searches turned up nothing under target on sale beyond one new full-price H72MWC15DL at $1,682, and Alberta Drywall's sweeps grew to 20 FlexVolt and 194 refurbished items with a narrower refurbished-60V pass on top, which found no refurbished 60V bare tool beyond the two already on the board. Canadian Tire's search came back to full width after three days stuck at 2 results — 18 hits for "dewalt 60v", 65 for the battery search — and the answer is unchanged: every DEWALT item is 12V or 20V MAX, and the only 60V packs are Greenworks and EGO. Rona is the same, 100 results and one 12V/20V charger. The Flipp sweep found UFA Co-operative's flyer rolled into a new run, Sept 24 – Oct 13, still carrying the DEWALT 60V 16-inch chainsaw kit at $499.99 from $579.99, which stays a lead rather than a row because Home Depot has the same DCCS670X1 at $498. KMS's monthly flyer still carries the same two unlabelled FlexVolt items at $278 and $428, unidentified for a sixth day because their clipping images sit on a host both browsers refuse.

An eleventh straight day with almost nothing moving on price, and the one exception is cosmetic: Amazon's DCB609 buy box passed back from savingsculture to Impact Distribution, so the listed price rises from $328.50 to $334 but delivery is free again and the landed cost is the same $334 it has been since Sept 12 — and the listing is no longer down to its last unit. Every other tracked row at Home Depot, KMS, Grainger, Walmart, Amazon and all seven Alberta Drywall rows read back at its last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the only pack inside the $24/Ah strong-buy line, and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. The day's good news is a restock: the matte-grey 72-inch heavy-duty Husky bench is buyable again at $1,548 from $1,898 with 4 available and free ship to Windermere, after five days marked gone — it is 18% off but still $149 above the $1,399 line, and the matte-black twin is still notify-me only. Home Depot's shelf also refilled on the DCB606, back from 0 to 3 at Windermere, though the DCB612 has slipped to limited stock with delivery unavailable and three online counts thinned (the DCBL777Y1 blower kit 25 to 18, the DCST970B trimmer 15 to 10, the DCST972B 45 to 43). No new SKU was worth adding: the Home Depot battery search put its only DeWalt markdowns on 20V packs, both Husky workbench searches turned up nothing under target on sale, and Alberta Drywall's sweeps grew to 19 FlexVolt and 179 refurbished items whose only additions — a refurbished DCV585T2R dust extractor kit at $735 and a full-price DCS577 worm-drive saw at $785 — are both beaten by rows already tracked. Two event notes: the online-only Must-See Deals week ends today, and a DEWALT MAX POWER brand event has opened at Home Depot that is entirely 20V MAX, with no 60V FlexVolt and no Husky tool storage in it. The Flipp sweep found a second flyer carrying 60V for the first time — UFA Co-operative, flyer 8139832 running to Oct 13, with a DEWALT 60V Max 16-inch chainsaw kit at $499.99 from $579.99 — but that is $1.99 above Home Depot's price for the same DCCS670X1 kit and 14% off, so it is a lead rather than a row. KMS's monthly flyer still carries the same two unlabelled FlexVolt items at $278 and $428, and they stay unidentified: the clipping images sit on f.wishabi.net, which was refused by both Chrome and the built-in browser today. Canadian Tire and Rona were re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt at all.

The ten-day standstill broke, though on the wrong side: Amazon's DCS578B bare circular saw jumped from $269 to $299 after Power Tools Inc's offer disappeared, and the new buy box adds $14.94 delivery on top, so the cheapest bare DCS578B anywhere is now $299 against Home Depot's $369 and KMS's $398. On the same site the DCB609 buy box passed from Impact Distribution to savingsculture at $328.50 with $5.50 shipping and a single unit left — a $5.50 cut on paper that lands at exactly the same $334. Every other price on the board held, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target, though it is down to 4 left online with none on the Windermere shelf. The day's find is a real flag: Home Depot's DCHT870B 26-inch hedge trimmer bare tool at $268 from $328 — 18% off, clearing the group's 15% line, with 5 on the shelf at Windermere — and two more bare 60V tools were added because they undercut rows already tracked, the DCBL770B blower at $239 against Alberta Drywall's $297 and the DCST970B 15-inch trimmer at $269 against its $279. A correction worth recording: the Home Depot store id used on the last run, 7024, is Barrie, not Windermere — Windermere is 7268 — so yesterday's Home Depot shelf counts were another store's, and today's were re-read against the right one. Everything else was quiet: KMS, Grainger and all seven Alberta Drywall rows held on price and stock, Walmart read cleanly and confirms the DCB612 at $328, both 72-inch heavy-duty Husky benches are still out, the Depot Drop week still runs to Sept 23 with no 60V or Husky pricing in it, and the Flipp sweep again found only KMS's monthly flyer with the same two unlabelled FlexVolt items at $278 and $428. Canadian Tire and Rona were re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt at all.

A ninth straight day without a single tracked price moving — every row the sweep could read came back at its last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. The day's real change is a loss: the matte-grey 72-inch heavy-duty Husky bench has gone out of stock online again, putting both 72-inch heavy-duty colours off the board and leaving the standard-duty gloss red at $1,198 as the only 72-inch still buyable. Home Depot's search grid refused to render, so the sweep ran through the site's own search API with the store set to Windermere, and it turned up two bare 60V tools the watch had been missing — the DCBL570B backpack blower at $698 from $759 and the DCPW1000B power cleaner at $298 from $329 — both added, though at 8% and 9% off neither clears the 15% line. Walmart read cleanly after yesterday's bot check and confirms the DCB612 at $328 from Preston Hardware, so that row is verified again, while the Amazon bare saw thinned from 4 units to 3 and both 61-inch Husky benches now read 0 on the Windermere shelf though both still ship to store free. Canadian Tire, Rona, KMS, Grainger and Alberta Drywall were all re-swept with nothing new: Canadian Tire's "dewalt 60v" search returned only 2 items today against 140 on earlier runs, but the answer is the same — no 60V FlexVolt anywhere in its range. The Flipp sweep again found only KMS's monthly flyer (Sept 1 – Oct 1) with two unlabelled FlexVolt items at $278 and $428 that still cannot be identified.

Eighth straight day without a price move — every row the sweep could read came back at its last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. The day's finds are both at Alberta Drywall: the bare-tool option of the DCST970X1 60V string trimmer at $279 with 4 in stock, which undercuts Home Depot's DCST972B bare trimmer by $20, and a DeWalt-refurbished 21-inch single-stage snow blower kit at $1,099 with 3 in stock, $200 under Home Depot's new DCSNP2142Y2-CA — a refurbished 60V tool, so it clears the group's clearance rule outright. Supply kept thinning at the edges: the Amazon bare saw is down from 5 units to 4, Home Depot's own DCS578B is down to a single unit at Windermere, and KMS slipped from 13 to 12 on the same saw at Abbotsford. Walmart could not be read — its DCB612 listing answered with a press-and-hold bot check, so that row is carried forward at $328 and marked unverified. Home Depot's Must-See Deals week is the same one running to Sept 23, and its 105-item Depot Drop list still holds exactly one DeWalt entry, a construction tripod at $89.25 from $119. The Flipp sweep again found only KMS's monthly flyer (Sept 1 – Oct 1) with two unlabelled FlexVolt items at $278 and $428 that still cannot be identified. Canadian Tire and Rona were both re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt at all.

Seventh straight day without a price move — every tracked row read back at its last-seen price, so the DCB609-2 9.0Ah 2-pack is still the best value on the board at $23.78/Ah and the 61-inch gloss-white Husky at $928 is still the only bench inside its target. The good news is a restock: the matte-grey 72-inch heavy-duty Husky bench is buyable again at $1,548 from $1,898, with an add-to-cart, delivery Sept 24–26 and free ship to Windermere, after reading out of stock yesterday — it is 18% off but still $149 above the $1,399 line, and the matte-black twin is still out. Widening the Alberta Drywall sweep added two 60V bare tools: a DeWalt-refurbished DCD130 mixer/drill bare tool at $279 with a single unit left, which clears the group's clearance rule outright and undercuts the same store's new DCD130 by $84.60, and the bare-tool option of the DCBL770X1 handheld blower at $297 with 3 in stock, against $499 for the kit. Supply kept thinning at the edges — the Amazon bare saw is down from 6 units to 5, and Walmart's DCB612 delivery slipped from Sept 25 to Sept 28 — while KMS is unchanged, still sold out at its lead store on the DCB612 and still $328 and $398 under MAP pricing. Home Depot's Must-See Deals week is the same one running to Sept 23, its only DeWalt entry a construction tripod at $89 from $119, with no 60V or Husky tool-storage pricing and the flyer widget rendering nothing again. Canadian Tire and Rona were both re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt at all.

Widening the Alberta Drywall sweep paid off with two 60V bare tools Home Depot does not list: a DCS388 FlexVolt reciprocating saw at $309.99 with 3 in stock, $59 under Home Depot's DCS389B, and a DeWalt-refurbished DCV585B dust extractor bare tool at $395 with 5 in stock — a refurbished bare tool, which clears the group's clearance rule outright. Supply thinned around the edges — the Amazon bare saw is down from 7 units to 6 with delivery pushed to Sept 24–28, the Amazon DCB609 slipped again to Sept 29 – Oct 7, and KMS now reads sold out at its lead store on the DCB612 after showing 10 yesterday, though it is still in stock online. Home Depot's Must-See Deals week is the same one, running to Sept 23, with no DeWalt 60V or Husky tool-storage pricing surfacing and the flyer widget rendering nothing again. Canadian Tire and Rona were both re-swept and still carry no 60V FlexVolt at all.

Two new Home Depot SKUs joined the 60V group, neither of them flagging: the DCBL777Y1 760 CFM blower kit with a 12Ah pack at $499 at regular price, and the DCCS670X1 16-inch chainsaw kit at $498 from $579 — 14% off, just under the 15% line, and out of stock at Windermere with delivery only.
